recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not change the active current ValueSet source for this R4B download issue; any renewed concern about historical R4B generation should be handled in the generation tooling path already represented by FHIR-35784/HL7 kindling work.
issue_request: FHIR-32816 was Published/Persuasive for R4B and reported that the generated valuesets.xml entry for http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/nhin-purposeofuse contained an invalid ConceptMap using relationship/source-is-* where R4/R4B required equivalence and wider/narrower-style values.
initial_application: No FHIR core source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-32816 was found. The checked R4B history artifact now uses equivalence values for the nhin-purposeofuse contained ConceptMap, while release5 and the active current source use the current relationship form.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes record FHIR-32816 as a technical correction to fix. The later same-change-family FHIR-35784 made the valuesets.xml relationship/equivalence tooling issue explicit, cited HL7/kindling#69, and already has an audit commit on the combined branch. A related Zulip thread about the same contained ConceptMap treated the R4B problem as tooling rather than source content.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Changing source/valueset/valueset-nhin-purposeofuse.xml to equivalence would be wrong for the current R5/R6 ConceptMap model, and tools/history/release4b/valuesets.xml no longer contains the invalid relationship/source-is-* representation.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive valuesets.xml issue that explicitly described the same relationship/equivalence generation problem and is already represented on the combined branch.
